messages:
Oncall Bot: Pager — elevated 5xxs observed for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Error spike started ~1748299900. Alert severity: P2. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/incident-gen-5xx
Jordan (SRE): I'm looking at genqueue metrics, backlog rising, a handful of GPU agents OOMing. collecting logs and pod states now.
Ava (Eng-Infra): Noted OOM on rwd-gpu-12 and rwd-gpu-13. Draining rwd-gpu-12 and restarting the node, will reprovision if it flaps.
Marta (Support): Field reports from AcmeCorp and BetaLabs — timeouts and partial replies. Compiling impacted customer list, drafting a short customer note.
Ravi (Product): For status page: propose an initial message with impact + mitigation. Keep ETA TBD.
Jordan (SRE): Draft statuspage copy: ```We are investigating elevated error rates affecting text generation in EU-West (eu-west-1). Impact: intermittent request failures and increased latency for some customers. Mitigation: engineers are performing rolling restarts and capacity increases. Next update in 30 mins.```
Ava (Eng-Infra): rwd-gpu-12 restart complete, pods are coming back, KV cache warming. Errors dropped from ~12% to ~4% after restart.
Jordan (SRE): Running smoke tests against representative workloads — generations succeed but tail latency still high. Watching queue depth and OOM counts.
Marta (Support): Draft customer note: "We're aware of intermittent generation failures for EU customers and have applied mitigation; we're monitoring and will update." Ready to send to impacted accounts once legal ok.
LegalOps: Quick review — wording looks fine, avoid conjecture about root cause. Keep phrasing: "engineers are investigating."
Ravi (Product): @here can we publish the initial statuspage now?
Jordan (SRE): :thumbsup: publish. I'll attach monitoring links and incident tags.
Oncall Bot: Statuspage update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1748300021 — initial update live.
Ava (Eng-Infra): Error rate now ~0.6%, node pool scaled +2. Continuing to observe for 20m.
Jordan (SRE): Smoke tests stable for 10m. If stable for another 10m, we'll post a resolved notice and close the pager. Recommend a short postmortem with timeline and autoscaler tuning action items.
Marta (Support): Sent customer note to impacted contacts. Included link to statuspage and contact info.
LegalOps: Confirmed no sensitive data included.
Oncall Bot: Resolved notice scheduled after stability window.
Jordan (SRE): Resolved: generation service recovered and error rates returned to baseline. Publishing resolved update and closing the incident. Postmortem owner: Jordan.
Ravi (Product): Thanks team — please add any follow-ups to the incident doc (autoscaler thresholds, OOM root cause investigation). :raised_hands:
